items.headline: “The death of Suno”: Reddit users have turned against Suno after v6 model update
items.excerpt: Suno's most loyal users are revolting against the v6 model update, calling the output worse than v5. The update also hasn't satisfied music labels: “V6 is not a fresh start; it is the fruit of the same poisoned tree.”

items.headline: ElevenLabs strikes first deal with a major label to launch AI-powered music platform and audio products
items.excerpt: Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs have partnered to launch a new AI-powered music platform and AI audio products. It is ElevenLabs' first licensing agreement with a major label.

items.headline: South Korea’s Komca withdrew plans to register AI-assisted music
items.excerpt: Komca had announced it would allow ‘AI-assisted’ music to be registered as works so long as a human made a creative contribution to lyrics, composition and arrangement — then pulled the plan.

items.headline: UMG and Sony Music file new Suno complaint over v6 models
items.excerpt: Suno's v6 models were trained on a fresh dataset including music licensed from WMG and BMG plus ‘user data’ — the two remaining major-label plaintiffs say that isn't a clean break.

items.headline: UMG’s ElevenLabs deal is latest move to AI remix experiences
items.excerpt: Another day, another AI-music deal for Universal Music Group — ElevenLabs signs its first agreement with a major, following Kobalt and Merlin, aimed at fan remix and mashup products.

items.headline: Universal and Sony sue Suno for a second time, claiming platform’s v6 models are ‘the fruit of the same poisoned tree’
items.excerpt: The new complaint targets Suno's industry-partnered v6 models. US copyright law sets damages for willful infringement at up to $150,000 per work; 60,202 recordings are cited.

items.headline: ElevenLabs launched Music v2.5 – shortly after announcing its UMG licensing deal
items.excerpt: The model went live on September 11 and is now the default “for prompted and reference generation” in ElevenMusic, the company said.

items.headline: Universal and Warner tell judge ‘new use’ clause in AFM agreement is “clear and unambiguous” and does not apply to their AI deals
items.excerpt: The American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, arguing the majors must share AI money with session players under the Sound Recording Labor Agreement.

items.headline: Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.excerpt: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, developed with industry partners like Warner Music, BMG and Believe, even as it fights other music companies in court.

items.headline: UMG Inks Deal With ElevenLabs to Develop AI Music Remix Platform
items.excerpt: Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs partner on a multi-year licensing and product deal to build an AI music remixing platform for fans, with opt-in artist participation and revenue share.

items.headline: "I'm cancelling my subscription": Suno users slam its V6 update as "muffled, generic, soulless garbage"
items.excerpt: Following the release of its industry-backed V6 models, some of the AI music platform's most enthusiastic supporters are abandoning ship.

items.headline: Lunacy launches Nova platform with five free virtual instruments – but bigger things are on the way
items.excerpt: The LA-based company is working on an AI-powered platform for prompt-based plugin development and customization, synchronized across your browser and your DAW.

items.headline: Brian May on why he’s changed his mind on AI: “We have to resist. We have to control it very, very seriously and very quickly”
items.excerpt: The Queen guitarist has reversed his earlier optimism about generative AI in music — and it's why he's gone cold on the idea of a Queen avatar show.

items.headline: Roland announces AI-assisted melody-generation plug-in, Melody Flip
items.excerpt: Roland's new plug-in is designed to work as a "music creation partner" that generates and reshapes melodic ideas rather than finished tracks.

items.headline: SSL 4K Bundle: Now With sonible AI!
items.excerpt: The SSL 4K Bundle, which provides authentic console-style processing workflows, now features sonible AI assistance in its latest update.

items.headline: Why This Sound Designer Isn't Afraid Of Generative AI SFX
items.excerpt: Sound designer and Dallas Audio Post co-owner René Coronado explains why generative AI sound-effects services don't threaten his craft — and where they actually fit in a post workflow.

items.headline: Dreamtonics Instrument X: How Good Does This Sample-Free Orchestra Sound?
items.excerpt: Dreamtonics' Instrument X swaps samples for neural synthesis to model orchestral instruments in real time. Here's what that means for your template, CPU load and sound.

items.headline: Free Tool Lets You Create Yamaha DX7 FM Patches Using Plain English
items.excerpt: DX7 AI Studio turns natural-language descriptions into FM patches for the notoriously opaque Yamaha DX7, promising to make programming the synth fun instead of forensic.

items.headline: New Mac App, HarmonyKeen, Writes Harmony Parts To Your MIDI Melodies Using Music Theory, Not AI
items.excerpt: Give it a monophonic MIDI melody and HarmonyKeen writes harmony parts around it, working out the voice leading — explicitly positioning rules-based music theory as the anti-AI alternative.

items.headline: Two Legs, Five Arms is a FREE generative drum machine for macOS
items.excerpt: François Pé has released Two Legs, Five Arms, a free generative drum machine and AU MIDI effect for macOS that builds drum patterns without programming every note manually.
